Why this matters

It was never only for the girls.

Girls get told how to dress their whole lives. Guys get told “just wear anything.” Then we're judged for it anyway. These are the struggles nobody talks about:

01Nobody taught usNo one sat us down to explain what goes with what. We learnt by guessing.
02Money no deyYou think looking good means spending big. It doesn't. It means buying right.
03The fear of doing too muchCare about your clothes and someone says “you dey form.” So we stop caring.
04Judged either wayLook careless and you're not taken seriously. Look sharp and you're “showing off.”

AORoyales is for the guy who wants to be a force and a voice, not “anyhow people.” We sell the clothes, and we show you how to match them.
